name: Dither, 8x8, three colours
doc: Ordered or random dithering on a coarse pixel grid (after paper.design Image Dithering).

p.f:
steps = 3
def q(v):
    x = v*(steps-1); lo = floor(x); return clip((lo + (x-lo > thr)) / max(steps-1, 1), 0, 1)
L = small @ array([0.299, 0.587, 0.114])
t = q(L)[..., None]
B, F, Hc = hexc("#000c38"), hexc("#94ffaf"), hexc("#eaff94")
lvl = rint(t*(steps-1))
g = clip((lvl-1)/max(steps-2, 1), 0, 1)
out = where(lvl == 0, B, F + (Hc-F)*g)
